_comment: Per-position P(win) priors for portfolio_kelly.py. cluster + rho_within define correlation-discount applied via Kelly fraction. cluster_frac is the existing-deployment-as-fraction-of-bankroll for that cluster — used as the discount factor. Resolved-market entries are pruned (git history preserves them).

trump-out-as-president-before-2027.rationale: 2026-07-03 prior-hygiene pass: 2026-06-10 skeptic+champion central P(YES) ~3% (death tail 1.5-2.2% at age 80 w/ presidential medicine + assassination 0.3-0.7% + resignation ~0.8% + removal ~0; Dem-House-flip seats AFTER resolution) -> p_no 0.97. Previous 0.96 carried extra entry-pessimism. Tails already inside the central; no further dated event. cluster_frac unchanged (assassination sliver correlates w/ iran-regime).

will-the-us-acquire-any-part-of-greenlan.rationale: 2026-07-03 prior-hygiene pass (monitoring prior = documented honest central; pessimism lives in entry gates only): 2026-06-10 catalyst check central P(YES) 2.5% [1-6%] -> p_no 0.975. Previous 0.95 was an entry-blend ("between pessimistic gate 0.915 and central 0.975"). No dated tail-event inside the horizon (unlike regime-fall's Aug-17/21 cliff), so central applies unweighted. Idiosyncratic tail class.

will-satoshis-identity-be-revealed-by-de.rationale: Subjective-resolution caveat ('revealed' could UMA-resolve loose on a splashy unproven claim — R-U risk category). Entered small (\$5.64) for that reason; NO ADDS despite Kelly deficit. p_no 0.99 = base rate of a 16-year mystery resolving in 6mo.

will-spacex-have-the-highest-ipo-market-.rationale: 2026-07-15 entry prior (DEC-0045): SpaceX Jun-12 IPO first-day close ~$2.1T = largest ever; no plausible 2026 rival (OpenAI pushed to 2027, needs +110% pop even if Dec). Residual 3%: shock mega-IPO + UMA share-count quibble. NOTE p_YES leg (we hold YES).

will-apple-release-a-touchscreen-macbook.rationale: 2026-07-15 entry prior (DEC-0046): Gurman Apr-2026 push to early-2027 (DRAM/NAND shortages, M5-chip reshuffle to hold THAT schedule); criteria need general-public purchasability by Dec-31. 15% = late-2026 ship not-ruled-out.

will-gpt-6-be-released-by-august-31-2026.rationale: 2026-07-19 HONEST UPDATE 0.96->0.90 after kimi_advisor second opinion pushed back (first live use of the tool): my 4% YES leaned wholly on a PRE-2026 'generations aren't surprise-dropped' base rate and underweighted 2026 cadence compression (5.5 Apr -> 5.6 Jul-9) + 'code red' competitive pressure + a reportedly-trained next model. Corrected fair YES ~10%. Kimi's own ~40% was market-anchored (circular for a mispricing book) and elided generation-vs-point-release (6 != 5.7), so NOT adopted — but its directional critique was valid. Position HOLDS: NO avg 0.644 vs fair 0.90 = still +25pp. Residual risk the market may see a scheduled event I can't (the honest reason it's not lower).

will-prime-video-announce-a-new-project-.rationale: 2026-07-16 entry prior (DEC-0050): loose bar (unannounced project OR new-season renewal via ANY official channel Jul 22-26); Prime SDCC programming confirmed + weekly press cadence; 22% = quiet-week tail (all in-window announcements happen to concern already-announced projects). If more SDCC-family legs are added they share this cluster.

will-marvel-studios-announce-a-new-proje.rationale: 2026-07-20 (DEC-0054): loose 'any new Marvel-entity project detail via any official channel Jul 22-26'; Hall H confirmed Jul-25. kimi-advised down from 0.83 (D23 Aug-14 = hold-reveals risk). Shares sdcc-window cluster w/ Prime-SDCC (rho 0.4).
